caption: The drawing depicts a single, large stoneware jug positioned upright on a plain, light background. The jug is beige or light brown in color and features a slightly glossy surface indicating a glazed finish. It has a rounded body, a narrow neck, and a small handle attached at the top, near the spout. Around the upper part of the jug, there is a decorative blue floral or abstract design painted on the front. Above the design, there is a blue stamped inscription that reads "I. HULDER BROS., ELIZABETH, N.J." The jug also has a brown stain near its bottom edge, and the rim of the spout appears slightly darker, possibly indicating a thicker glaze. There are no additional objects in the drawing, and the background remains unadorned and neutral.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
